definition: to turn on the computer
exampleSentence: I switch on the computer when I get to the office.
exampleTranslation: Đến văn phòng là tôi bật máy tính.

definition: to type your name and password to use a computer or website
exampleSentence: I log in to my email every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng đăng nhập vào email.

definition: to send an email you received to another person
exampleSentence: Please forward the email to the team.
exampleTranslation: Vui lòng chuyển tiếp email này cho cả nhóm.

definition: to add a file to an email
exampleSentence: Don't forget to attach the file.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên đính kèm tệp nhé.

definition: to start to look at a computer file
exampleSentence: I can't open this file.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không mở được tệp này.

definition: to choose a time for a meeting
exampleSentence: Let's schedule a meeting for Thursday.
exampleTranslation: Mình lên lịch họp vào thứ Năm nhé.

definition: to reserve a room for a meeting
exampleSentence: I booked a meeting room for two o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã đặt phòng họp lúc hai giờ.

definition: to get to your office
exampleSentence: I arrive at the office at eight thirty.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đến văn phòng lúc tám rưỡi.

definition: to go out of the office at the end of work
exampleSentence: We leave the office at six.
exampleTranslation: Sáu giờ chúng tôi rời văn phòng.

definition: to record the time when you start work
exampleSentence: Remember to clock in when you arrive.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ chấm công khi đến nơi.

definition: to record the time when you finish work
exampleSentence: I clock out at five thirty.
exampleTranslation: Năm rưỡi tôi chấm công ra.

definition: to stop work for a short time to drink coffee
exampleSentence: We have a coffee break at eleven.
exampleTranslation: Mười một giờ chúng tôi nghỉ uống cà phê.

definition: to make your desk neat
exampleSentence: I tidy my desk before I go home.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dọn bàn làm việc trước khi về nhà.

definition: to phone your work to say you are ill
exampleSentence: She called in sick this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay cô ấy gọi điện báo ốm.

definition: to ask your boss for time off
exampleSentence: I asked for leave in August.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã xin nghỉ phép vào tháng Tám.

definition: to ask your boss to pay you more money
exampleSentence: He asked for a raise.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy xin tăng lương.

definition: to tell your boss you are leaving your job
exampleSentence: She handed in her notice yesterday.
exampleTranslation: Hôm qua cô ấy nộp đơn xin nghỉ việc.

definition: to go and talk to someone who may give you a job
exampleSentence: I'm going for an interview on Friday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Sáu tôi đi phỏng vấn.

definition: to complete a piece of work
exampleSentence: I need to finish this task today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tôi cần hoàn thành việc này.

definition: to take action to solve a problem
exampleSentence: I have to deal with a problem at work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải xử lý một vấn đề ở chỗ làm.

definition: to write replies to emails
exampleSentence: I spend an hour answering emails.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dành một tiếng để trả lời email.

definition: to look at your diary to see your plans
exampleSentence: Let me check my diary.
exampleTranslation: Để tôi xem lại lịch hẹn.

definition: to say that you will not come to a meeting you arranged
exampleSentence: I had to cancel an appointment.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải hủy một lịch hẹn.

definition: to travel for work
exampleSentence: My boss is going on a business trip.
exampleTranslation: Sếp tôi sắp đi công tác.
